description: This file defines a plugin entry for a Copilot Proxy provider, including configuration and registration logic, with functions for URL normalization, validation, and model definition.

methods.name: normalizeBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a URL by trimming, removing trailing slashes, and appending /v1 if missing.

methods.name: validateBaseUrl
methods.description: Validates the normalized URL, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: parseModelIds
methods.description: Parses a comma- or newline-separated string into a set of unique model IDs.

methods.name: buildModelDefinition
methods.description: Creates a model definition object with default parameters for a given model ID.
